test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

UC, AE, GG, MI, SK, ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d26a4107141c8988092be3a6f971de10fd85269bdcee88518465cc72c114f65.png] 

Given: UC, AE, GG, MI, SK, ?

The logic followed here is: 

 
• **First letters + 6**
 
• **Second letter + 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9246612c8a6052a48d8c4fdf1fdcf35dc8ecc84450e018313f15cfd973208105.png] 

Hence, **YM **is the correct answer.
